## Selected work

### [RAG Forensics](https://github.com/SriMed/rag-forensics)

An inspectable diagnostic record for investigating why a RAG answer may have gone wrong.

### [Measuring Emergent Misalignment](https://github.com/SriMed/em-signal-validity)

Comparing a base model with an emergently misaligned fine-tune to investigate what differences in behavior and internal activations can tell us.
